limitations: all hypothetical observation variances are equal; only correlation changes
the separable covariance family is illustrative and is not estimated from raw blocks
unit-column scaling removes absolute q/h/x signal amplitude
no measured covariance, fit, bootstrap, interval coverage, or force bound is used
the underlying energies remain the hand-set values from the companion toy

model.R_Nt: [[1,rho_Nt],[rho_Nt,1]] for paired N_t=16,32; identity for single extent
model.condition_metric: unit-column-scaled condition number after covariance whitening; reports shape only
model.covariance: Sigma = R_Nt ⊗ R_T, with unit marginal variances
model.whitening: L^-1 X where Sigma=L L^T; no regularization or covariance fitting
